messages:
sre-bot: PagerDuty -> P0: High 5xx rate and latency on inference gateway across /v1/chat and /v1/embeddings for the last 3m. Error rate 18% (baseline 0.3%). Affected regions: us-west-2. Trigger: gateway-5xx-threshold.
Anya P.: ACK. I'm taking it. Starting triage.
sre-bot: Related alerts: token-backpressure rising on gpu-pool-3, queue length spike on inference-router.
Anya P.: Quick check — are we seeing a single model or multiple? Kai, can you pull model-level metrics?
Kai M.: Pulling. Initial look: embeddings endpoints are saturating IO on a subset of hosts running on q4-40. Chat requests also spiking, but chat 95th latency increased mostly when rerank calls are attached.
Anya P.: Hypothesis: embeddings heavy clients + rerank fans out causing connection/memory pressure and kernel preemption. We need immediate mitigation to reduce customer impact.
Chris L.: Agreed. Proposed live mitigations (short list): 1) Apply route-specific soft rate limits: chat -> 60 rps global, embeddings -> 20 rps global; 2) Temporarily disable rerank fanout; 3) Lower max tokens for chat to 1024; 4) Redirect non-critical traffic to fallback quantized model (m-small-v1) for bursty customers.
Mel S.: +1. Also recommend increasing per-customer burst window for paying accounts only (ACME burst allow) so we don't throttle enterprise SLAs.
Anya P.: Let's do minimal set first: embeddings rate cap + disable rerank. I'll push changes via console and API and watch. Updating runbook step 2.
Anya P.: Runbook command: 
```bash
# apply per-endpoint soft limits via gateway feature flags
curl -X POST https://console.api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/limits \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/embeddings","limit_rps":20,"type":"soft"}'

curl -X POST https://console.api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/limits \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/chat","limit_rps":60,"type":"soft","max_tokens":1024}'
```
Anya P.: Applying now.
sre-bot: deploy-bot triggered: config-change /admin/limits by Anya P. (tx id 0x8f3b). Rollout 100% in us-west-2 starting.
deploy-bot: rollout: limits-config v2026.3.15.1 -> 12 hosts in us-west-2.
Kai M.: Seeing gradual drop in queue depth on inference-router. embeddings tail latency dropping immediately.
Chris L.: Proceeding to disable rerank at the gateway layer (route-specific flag).
Anya P.: Command: 
```json
{
  "route": "/v1/rerank",
  "enabled": false,
  "reason": "emergency mitigation - causes fanout"
}
```
Anya P.: Disabled rerank. Confirming 200->204 response for requests that previously hit rerank, clients will get fallback ordering.
Mel S.: Observability: marking affected customers list in the incident doc to reach out after stabilization: acme-inc, beta-labs, two-startups. ACME is on enterprise, we'll exempt them from embeddings cap for now.
Chris L.: Applied exception: acme-inc embeddings limit -> 100 rps (in config).
Kai M.: Metrics: embeddings 5xx rate down to 4.2% within 2m, overall 4xx/5xx volume decreasing. Token backpressure on gpu-pool-3 reduced by ~45%.
Anya P.: Good. Next: limit reroute for non-critical zones to quantized fallback. Chris, can you flip routing policy to prefer m-small-v1 for routes with high token counts (>512) for best-effort customers?
Chris L.: On it — updating routing policy: 
```yaml
routing_policy:
  - match: {request.route: "/v1/chat", request.tokens_gt: 512, customer_tier: free}
    action: route_to: m-small-v1
    priority: 10
```
Chris L.: Policy applied as canary to 20% of traffic.
Kai M.: Observability note: adding a dashboard panel to separate endpoint-level error rates (chat, embeddings, rerank) and model-level resource contention.
Anya P.: Customer impact: reduced but not eliminated. We're seeing degraded quality for some free-tier chat users and delayed embeddings for heavy API keys. Enterprise traffic (ACME) unaffected due to exception. I'll post a brief status update to #incidents and #support.
Anya P.: Status update (to incidents): "We identified a traffic pattern causing embeddings and rerank to amplify backend pressure. Implemented per-endpoint soft RPS caps, disabled rerank, and applied fallback routing to quantized model. Error rates dropping; mitigation in effect. Working on follow-ups: improved autoscale for embeddings pool, permanent route-specific quotas, and postmortem."
Mel S.: Next steps for postmortem: collect top-10 API keys by embedding qps, audit client SDK versions to see if one client misbehaves, evaluate whether rerank endpoint should have built-in circuit breaker.
Chris L.: I'll take next shift for monitoring while Anya documents actions and ownership. Handing off oncall in 10m.
Anya P.: Handoff ack — Chris will own until next rotation. Closing action items: 1) run smoke tests after 15m, 2) prepare customer comms for affected free-tier users, 3) schedule infra change to add limiters in the serving runtime.
Chris L.: All right — I'm watching dashboards. If error rate dips below 0.5% for 20m we can start re-enabling rerank behind a circuit breaker.
Anya P.: Thanks team. Filing incident ticket INC-2026-315 with timeline. We'll follow up with RCA and per-route quota recommendations (e.g., default embeddings rps, dedicated enterprise pools).
Mel S.: Noted for post-incident review. Good mitigation work. :thumbsup:
